answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow blocks bulk fakes. A newcomer locks twice 30 days of earnings, then works 20 epochs for a fingerprint. An island of clones is spotted because their fingerprints echo each other, velvet-smooth copies included. Only unique fingerprints unlock deposits. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 deposits and 20 epochs of work each, more than the split rewards, so forgery loses money. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
